risks.title: Volatility in crude oil and natural gas prices
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in Item 1A, cited as a key factor affecting results. Language is strong: downside risk, volatility, uncertainty. The 14.5% decline in WTI prices in 2025 exacerbates exposure. Macro category weighted heavily in the energy sector.

risks.title: Contraction in global drilling activity
risks.score_rationale: Presented in key indicators: 6.6% decline in global drilling in 2025. Direct impact on revenue and margin. Repeated mention across segments. Clear link to operational performance.

risks.title: Inflationary pressures and tariff increases
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in Energy Products and Services as affecting profitability. Mention of tariffs and cost pressures. Direct impact on gross margin. Persistent inflationary context in 2025.

risks.title: Decline in demand for parts and services
risks.score_rationale: Identified in Energy Equipment as cause of sales mix deterioration. Reduction in spare parts orders and aftermarket services. Recurring impact on profitability despite revenue growth.

risks.title: OPEC+ commercial decisions
risks.score_rationale: Cited as major source of uncertainty. Production additions by OPEC+ exacerbate price pressure. Strong language: larger than anticipated. Systemic risk to supply-demand balance.

risks.title: Market share loss or competition
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in order loss: book-to-bill at 73% versus 121%. Though offset by North American market share gains, decline in international new orders is concerning. Less directly stated, but inferred from operational trends.

risks.title: Asset impairments and plant closures
risks.score_rationale: Present across multiple segments: Energy Equipment and corporate. Restructuring costs, asset write-downs and facility closures. Significant amounts: $79M in Other Items. Sign of structural rebalancing.

ai_positioning.summary: NOV does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. There is no significant mention of AI in the provided text.
